title: Language & Regional Vocabulary Governance Verification (Hardened)

checks.description: Spanish is registered as a supported language.

Exactly one Spanish publication DEFINITION exists in the registry (urlPrefix "/es") and it is currently UNPUBLISHED — this check certifies the registry's declared state, not generated output (V12/V13 certify output separately).
Exactly five Spanish vocabulary profiles exist: neutral, mx, es, cl, ca.
No regional profile carries publication-like fields (url prefix, sitemap, canonical, etc.) — profiles are vocabulary metadata only.
No /es-XX/ country-specific URL namespace directory exists anywhere in the repository tree (recursive scan, not limited to top level).

evidence.exclusionJustification: .git is VCS storage, not repository content, and cannot hold a publication directory.

checks.description: Schema contract requires entity_id to reference an existing ontology id (checked now). Populated-entry cross-reference validation is a SEPARATE, deferred concern — LANG-01 is schema-only (entries: []), so there is nothing yet to cross-reference; this PASSES on the schema contract alone and explicitly states population validation is deferred, rather than implying entries were checked.

evidence.population_validation_note: LANG-02+ MUST validate each populated entry's entity_id against the live catalogs before this check can certify populated data — that validation does not exist yet and this check does not claim it does.

checks.description: No source file in lib/, scripts/, or assets/js/ hardcodes regional-vocabulary branching — strict/loose equality on region or profile against any of the 5 approved profile ids, switch/case on a profile id, or a hardcoded object literal keyed by all 5 profile ids (a de-facto vocabulary map in code). lib/language-config.js (the approved registry) and this verification tooling are excluded — see SELF_REFERENTIAL_FILES.
Preferred term (single string) and aliases (array) are declared as distinct field types in the schema.
The regional fallback chain's root profile is "neutral".

The pairing engine (pairing-engine.js, pairing-data.js, engine.js, matrix-view.js) contains no Spanish localization strings used as machine values, no language-selection branching (language/lang/locale compared against "es"), and no regional-profile branching (the same structural patterns V8 checks for application code generally, applied specifically here). The Spanish-word check is one additional signal, not the sole mechanism.
No /es/ directory exists in the published output.
sitemap.xml contains no /es/ URLs and no sitemap-es reference.

REGISTRY-LEVEL check only: English is the default language, English is published, Spanish is not published, and no other language is published — i.e. listPublishedLanguageIds() === ["en"]. This does NOT itself prove English publication files are unchanged on disk; that evidence comes from `git status`/`git diff`, reported separately by the calling script.

note: This module performs registry-, schema-, and repository-tree-level checks only. It has no git dependency by design (matching lib/schema-audit and lib/search-audit's established pattern). Two categories of evidence it explicitly does NOT itself provide — (a) that existing English publication files, sitemap.xml, and ontology/runtime/editorial/wine data are byte-unchanged, and (b) that no populated vocabulary entry (there are currently none) resolves to a nonexistent catalog entity — are provided by the calling script via `git status`/`git diff` and by V7's explicit population-validation-deferred status respectively.
